meta.label_task_description: Proxy classification of non-permanent surface water presence. Band 2 of the WorldFloods GT mask records ALL detected water, not flood-specific water. Permanent water (JRC value 3) is excluded. The resulting 'flood' label means 'significant non-permanent water detected', which is a useful but imperfect proxy for actual flooding.
